_comment: Per-asset gate budgets, enforced by gate.mjs. Patterns are glob-lite: '*' matches within a filename. maxExtent = largest bounding-box dimension in meters. nodeContract asserts the addressing nodes the rules engine needs.

tumbles.glb._comment: 7 slot nodes sharing one placeholder collision-proxy hull; runtime swaps in pool shell meshes. Extent = the proxy mesh (bounds ignore node transforms).
